lines.text: By twenty-one hundred, under high emissions, Alaska could get more than double, up to nearly seven times, today's ground strikes.
lines.t: By twenty-one hundred, under high emissions, Alaska could get more than double, up to nearly seven times, today's ground strikes.

lines.text: That's from a new study in Earth's Future.
lines.t: That's from a new study in Earth's Future.

lines.text: Andreas Krause's team built it with a machine learning model.
lines.t: Andreas Krause's team built it with a machine learning model.

lines.text: It learned from six everyday weather readings, and where ground strikes landed.
lines.t: It learned from six everyday weather readings, and where ground strikes landed.

lines.text: Remember this. It trained on one year of data, twenty nineteen.
lines.t: Remember this. It trained on one year of data, twenty nineteen.

lines.text: On today's climate, most of Alaska got under one strike per square kilometer a year.
lines.t: On today's climate, most of Alaska got under one strike per square kilometer a year.

lines.text: That future could bring a hundred sixteen to five hundred ninety-four percent more.
lines.t: That future could bring a hundred sixteen to five hundred ninety-four percent more.

lines.text: For the world's land, seventy-six to a hundred forty percent more.
lines.t: For the world's land, seventy-six to a hundred forty percent more.

lines.text: Lightning fires burned at least ninety-three percent of Alaska's wildfire acres every year for a decade.
lines.t: Lightning fires burned at least ninety-three percent of Alaska's wildfire acres every year for a decade.

lines.text: The study didn't model fire, only lightning, the spark behind those acres.
lines.t: The study didn't model fire, only lightning, the spark behind those acres.

lines.text: Krause, the lead author, said, I was quite surprised that the projections were so high.
lines.t: Krause, the lead author, said, I was quite surprised that the projections were so high.

lines.text: Run backward on the nineteen hundreds, the model estimated about twelve percent more lightning per degree.
lines.t: Run backward on the nineteen hundreds, the model estimated about twelve percent more lightning per degree.

lines.text: Earlier studies projected eight to seventeen percent per degree. Run forward, its own twelve could nearly triple, to thirty percent.
lines.t: Earlier studies projected eight to seventeen percent per degree. Run forward, its own twelve could nearly triple, to thirty percent.

lines.text: Per the press release, earlier studies differ from this one mostly in math. Krause calls lightning's response quite a large uncertainty.
lines.t: Per the press release, earlier studies differ from this one mostly in math. Krause calls lightning's response quite a large uncertainty.

lines.text: A month earlier, Krause and Anja Rammig posted a preprint testing lightning models. A simple average beat the machine learning ones.
lines.t: A month earlier, Krause and Anja Rammig posted a preprint testing lightning models. A simple average beat the machine learning ones.

lines.text: Their advice, test models outside their training conditions.
lines.t: Their advice, test models outside their training conditions.

lines.text: In fairness, this paper says its model beat a regression and three existing formulas.
lines.t: In fairness, this paper says its model beat a regression and three existing formulas.

lines.text: Read it as a range. Even its low end could more than double Alaska's lightning.
lines.t: Read it as a range. Even its low end could more than double Alaska's lightning.

lines.text: The whole range waits on a test outside its training data.
lines.t: The whole range waits on a test outside its training data.

lines.text: One June Sunday in twenty twenty-four put nearly seven thousand strikes on Alaska. Who should run that test?
lines.t: One June Sunday in twenty twenty-four put nearly seven thousand strikes on Alaska. Who should run that test?
